texts.preamble: Ujala Mahila Swa-Sahayata Samuh vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 28 July, 2025 1 2025:Cghc: High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur Wpc No. 3975 of 2025 Ujala Mahila Swa-Sahayata Samuh, Through President Shabana Ansari W/o Imamuddin Ansari, Aged About 36 Years, R/o Pump House Korba, District Korba (C.G.) ... Petitioner(s) versus 1 - State Of Chhattisgarh Through The Under Secretary, Education Department, Mahanadi Bhawan, Mantralaya Atal Nagar, Naya Raipur (C.G.) 2 - Collector Food Department Branch Korba, District Korba (C.G.) 3 -Sub-Divisional Officer (R) Korba, District Korba 4 - Block Division Education Officer Korba, District Korba (C.G.) 5 - Mano Kanta Paul Principal, Swami Atmananad English School, Balco Korba, District Korba (C.G.) 6 - Ekta Swa Sahayata Samuh Through Its President Sector-3 Balco, District Korba (C.G.) 7 - Kausal Prasad R/o Bhadrapara, Ward No. 40, Balco Nagar, District Korba (C.G.) 8 - Sakun Thakur R/o Bhadrapara, Ward No. 40, Balco Nagar, District Korba (C.G.). ---- Respon ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- For Petitioner : Mr. Awadh Tripathi, Advocate. For Respondent-State : Ms. Upasana Mehta, Dy. Ga. Ujala Mahila Swa-Sahayata Samuh vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 28 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63412369/ 1 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Hon'ble Shri Arvind Kumar Verma, Judge Order on Board 28.07.2025 1.
texts.facts: Brief facts of this case are that the petitioner has filed this writ petition being aggrieved by the impugned order passed by the respondent no. 3 for the purpose of forming an investigation team against the petitioner's operation for mid-day meal at Swami Atmanand English Medium School, Balco Nagar, Korba by anonymous complainant filed by the respondent no.7 & 8, which was moved with the motive to harass the petitioner and somehow bring hindrance in the operation of the mid-day meal provided by the petitioner at the said aforesaid school. Thereafter, the petitioner has filed the writ petition (WPC No.3093/2025) before this Court, which was disposed of on 18.07.2025, relevant portion of said order/direction reads as under: "7. Considering above facts of the case, submissions of counsel for the parties, writ petition is disposed of at this stage permitting the petitioner to submit fresh representation before the concerned respondents- authorities within 15 days and in-turn concerned Authority shall conduct an enquiry regarding testing/verifying the quality of food supplied by the petitioner and also give proper opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and, thereafter, pass appropriate order on its own merit within 30 days from the date of receipt of copy of such representation. 8. The respondent-authority concerned is directed to permit/allow the petitioner-group to continue the work of preparation of Mid-Day-Meal in the concerned School till the inquiry is completed, however, petitioner-group is also directed to maintain the hygiene and quality of food as per standard of the food Safety." After knowing about the aforesaid order passed by this Court, the respondent-authority for the very purpose to frustrate the right of the petitioner and also frustrate the order of this Court and directed the private respondent no.6 to run the Mid-day meal program in the concerned School. The Inquiry Officer has made an enquiry and submitted the report vide Annexure P-3 before the concerned respondent-authority.
texts.arguments: 10.3. Any other relief which deemed fit and proper may also be issued looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the interest of justice." 2. 5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that impugned order dated 15.04.2025 is a non-speaking order as same has been passed only on the basis of enquiry report and without giving proper opportunity of hearing to the petitioner. He further contended that aforesaid order of this Court's dated 18.07.2025 was uploaded on the website on 22.07.2025 and on that day the petitioner has met with the District Education Officer and Sub Divisional Officer Korba and informed about the said order passed by this Court, but the respondent No.3 with malafide intention has passed the impugned order dated 22.07.2025 contrary to the relevant provision of law. 6. Learned State Counsel submits that based on complaint made with regard to quality of the food supplied by petitioner is not upto the mark, the Committee has been constituted to enquire the food quality supplied by the petitioner in the Swami Atmanand English Medium School. The Committee has found that there is poor quality of food supplied by the petitioner and, thereafter, respondent-authority has passed the impugned order and detached the petitioner from the work of preparation of Mid-Day-Meal in Swami Atmanand English School. Learned State Counsel further contended that during the enquiry petitioner was not present on the spot, therefore, opportunity of hearing could not be given to him. 7.
